definicoes_ingles: (b. h.) Gabriel, name of an angel ( Divine Strength).
notas_ingles: Dan. VIII, 16; a. e. Gen. R. s. 1, beg. Ex. R. s. 1. Y. Ber. I, 13 a bot. לא יצווח לא לג' וכ' man in distress must not invoke Gabriel &c,; a. v. fr.
Sabb. 67 b kill this hen שקרתה ג' for she crowed like a cock (a superstitious practice); (Tosef. ib. VI (VII), 5 שקראה כזכר).
f. (b. h.) = גְּבִירָה. Gen. R. s. 51 בן גְּבִרְתָּהּ her mistress’ son. Ib. s. 45 (גְּבִירְ') גְּבִרְתִּי my mistress; a. e.
, v. גְּבַר II
Sifré Deut. 305; Yalk. ib. 941 ג' (ש)כמותך a hero (who is) like thyself.

Num. R. s. 7 (ref. to אָנוּשׁ Is. XVII, 11, v. גָּבַר) leprosy is called a strong disease מפני שהיא מכה ג' (not הג') because it is an overpowering affliction; Lev. R. s. 18 מכה ג' ומתשת an overpowering and weakening &c.

definicoes_ingles: to be high, piled up ; denom. גָּבוּשׁ. | to fill with piles of stones.
notas_ingles: Tosef. Oh. XVII, 9 שגִּבְּשֹׁו בגבושים which he filled up &c.; (Oh. XVIII, 5 רצף באבנים).
Targ. Prov. VI, 8 ed. (Ms. גדש').
